justification: The witness is valid: all 54 vertices have degree 3, and coordinate/value permutations act transitively on incident point-line pairs. The distance-4 sphere contains 12 vertices around a point but 4+6+6=16 around a line, preventing vertex-transitivity. This realizes the same semisymmetric mechanism as the Folkman reference: edge-transitivity with two distinct bipartition vertex orbits.
